responsibility: Exposes the shared core and workspace services to agents as MCP tools with generated input and output schemas, structured content, bounded context and previews.
owns: Tool registration with compact advertised schemas, the schema resources that hold the full contract, schema-conforming structured content with a text fallback, and protocol compatibility results.
boundary: No alternative mutation, readiness or acceptance policy.
Record text and retrieved documents are returned as data and never grant tool authority.
An advertised schema is a compact view; every call is validated against the full contract before anything runs.

provides.name: tools
provides.concurrency: A persistent mutation requires the expected base revision; two agents editing one prior revision cannot both succeed.

provides.name: schemaResources
provides.concurrency: The full contract of one definition at loom://schema/<Definition>, immutable for the contract digest it names; an unknown definition is a resource-not-found protocol error.
